tests.command: Windows dev host, Git Bash, every command foreground with an explicit timeout <=5min, --test-threads=1, Store with --no-fail-fast. Cumulative counts taken through `rtk proxy cargo test ...` (unfiltered) with the full stream tee'd to a file, then summed over EVERY 'test result:' line by an awk pass that also names any suite with non-zero failed/filtered-out and a grep for FAILED/panicked/error; nothing was suppressed and no filtering pipe sits in the test path itself. Plain `rtk cargo test` was used ONLY for the non-counting build/check/clippy/fmt gates (it truncates long test runs, so it is never used for counts). This iteration QA authored/strengthened NO test file (strengthen-only respected) — the refine is a pure move that must not touch tests, and the fact that the identical iteration-1 suites stay green with zero edits is itself the proof of behaviour preservation. BEHAVIOUR-DRIFT AUDIT (refine claims ZERO behaviour change): diffed all three declared files against sandbox/r-code-v1-safety/iter/P19B-R/before/ (the PRE-task baseline, which carries no effect surface) and read crates/r-code-runtime/src/application/effect_approvals.rs in full. The move is pure code motion — application.rs now differs from before/ only by (a) `pub mod effect_approvals;` plus `pub use effect_approvals::{EffectApprovalView, StoreEffectApprovals, EFFECT_APPROVE_SCOPE};` (keeps crate::application::StoreEffectApprovals resolving at run_manager.rs:1446 and the r_code_runtime::application paths in the suites, so neither consumer file needed an import edit), (b) the additive `effect` binding row in approvals_list, and (c) approvals_decide keeping its exact 3-arg signature while delegating at session=actor to the new approvals_decide_with_session that carries the effect-grant logic. Exactly three helpers changed private->pub(super) (validate_effect_binding_current, find_active_effect, materialize_effect_approval) because approvals_decide_with_session stays in application.rs and calls them across the child-module boundary; current_effect_binding stayed private (only called inside the module). A child module sees its ancestor's private fields, so self.store/self.approvals needed NO visibility widening and no pub(crate) churn. approval_store.rs and bin/r-code-service.rs are byte-identical to their iteration-1 CODE (the before/ diff shows only iteration-1 additions plus the refine's comment-only header trim, content relocated onto the EVENT_REQUESTED/EVENT_DECIDED constant docs). SECURITY-CRITICAL LOGIC verified intact by direct read: (1) fail-closed EffectApprovalSource — has_exact_approval is find_active_effect_approval(...).map(is_some).unwrap_or(false), so any lookup error denies authority; (2) the binding is derived ONLY from the currently-approved plan head — current_effect_binding loads current_plan_revision + load_active_plan_approval, asserts approval.plan_revision == plan.reference(), and takes effect_class/network_ceiling/work_unit_payload_hash from the approved wire, never from client params (task_id/work_unit_id only select the unit) or mutable settings; (3) staleness is validated BEFORE the decision is journaled — in approvals_decide_with_session the validate_effect_binding_current call (application.rs:582) precedes self.approvals.decide(...) at :589-592, so a stale binding propagates Err and the pending op is neither consumed nor minted; (4) already-materialized carve-out — validation is skipped when find_active_effect is Some, so an exact approval still answers replays after the plan legitimately moves; (5) deny/expiry persist nothing — effect is Some only when decision==Granted and materialize runs only inside Ok(record) with effect Some; (6) revoke is future-runs-only — effect_approval_revoke supersedes the store row and never rewrites frozen RunSnapshot rows, only the next freeze re-consults and fails closed; (7) approval_id is immutable — materialize_effect_approval uses operation_id as approval_id and on EffectApprovalIdConflict/EffectActiveApprovalExists returns the existing active row, else errors effect_approval_conflict, so a granted-then-revoked id can never re-mint. CUMULATIVE (each via rtk proxy, unfiltered, summed): -p r-code-runtime --all-features --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=1 = 445 passed / 0 failed over 85 'test result:' lines, cargo exit 0; -p r-code-kernel = 84/0 over 16 lines; -p r-code-store --no-fail-fast = 425 passed / 1 failed / 426 over 17 lines (cargo exit 101, the single failure the declared plan_schema baseline); -p r-code-harness-protocol -p r-code-harness-sdk = 33/0 over 9 lines; -p r-code-harness-codex = 13/0 over 7 lines. Cumulative 1001 total / 1000 passed / 1 failed — IDENTICAL to the round-1 1001/1000/1 and equal to the 987/986/1 P19A baseline plus the 14 s19br tests, so the pure move changed no count: regression_green. COUNT INTEGRITY, stated plainly: the Runtime raw sum again contains the two known 'test result: ok. 1 passed; ... 10 filtered out' child-process echo lines (captured at /tmp/rt_runtime.txt lines 413 and 419) — crates/r-code-runtime/tests/s00_boot_identity.rs::current_identity_is_stable_in_process_and_across_restarted_processes re-spawns its own test binary twice and the children inherit stdout; the s00 suite truth is 11 passed and the distinct-test Runtime truth is 443, but the raw 445 is reported because the recorded 431/445 baselines carry the same two echoes under the house summation rule; both numbers stated, nothing silently de-duplicated. WORKSPACE GATES: rtk cargo test --workspace --all-features --no-run exit 0; rtk cargo check --workspace --all-features exit 0 (warm, 0 crates recompiled); rtk cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings exit 0 ('No issues found' — full workspace, broader than the runtime-only clippy the orchestrator confirmed); rtk cargo fmt --all -- --check exit 0 (no diff). OTHER GATES: node scripts/harness-packaging.test.mjs = 2 pass / 0 fail in 5.78s (the second case really builds r-code-service + r-code-harness-native and boots the daemon over a path containing spaces); rtk proxy python.exe .agents/skills/plan-loop/tools/validate_plan.py --tasks docs/support/archive/prd/r-code-v1/worklists/safety.tasks.json -> ok=true, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 39 tasks / 11 components covered; rtk proxy python.exe .agents/skills/swe-loop/tools/quality_check.py over the 5 changed production files AND QA's 2 test files (--max-comment-block 12 --max-comment-line-len 100 --max-func-loc 100 --max-nesting 5 --max-file-loc 2600) -> ok=TRUE, 0 violations (application.rs 2421 loc / block 11; application/effect_approvals.rs 438 / 8; plugins/approval_store.rs 489 / 12; bin/r-code-service.rs 1105 / 8; run_manager.rs 2351 / 11; tests/s19br_effect_approval_flow.rs 1320 / 12; tests/s19a_effect_snapshot_gate.rs 442 / 1) — all three round-1 violations (application.rs file_loc 2856>2600, application.rs max_comment_block 18>12, approval_store.rs max_comment_block 27>12) are resolved and every file is inside every threshold.
